vibe.verdict: The real Burger Den, Jaffe's 'usual lunch or usual dinner', the one-bite hot dog and the 2-11 receipt make this a fan's menu; the poppers, pretzels and Ghirardelli are still San Francisco filler.
missing: The wounded robber's reply: 'I gots to know' (bank steps)
The phone booth run across the city (only a wink)
The cross on Mount Davidson (only a wink)

Swap 'Sourdough and salted butter' for a hot dog still being chewed: 'Harry walks out mid-bite'
Swap the poppers note for the full beat: 'Six shots or only five? He kind of lost track.'
